dedupe_keys.name: google earth engine community catalog metadata and asset access directory

description: The Google Earth Engine Community Catalog documents community-contributed geospatial datasets made available as Earth Engine assets. Contributors publish metadata tables, dataset pages, source references and code snippets that identify image collections or feature collections. The repository describes a complement to the official Earth Engine catalogue, intended to make research data usable without repeating ingestion and preprocessing. Infrastructure examples include predicted power-distribution layers with documented raster resolutions and transmission-line feature collections. Coverage is global but dates, resolution, quality and licensing vary by asset. The catalogue metadata are freely available under CC BY 4.0; individual data assets retain their own stated licences, and using Earth Engine requires the corresponding service access. A limitation is that aggregate homepage counts are changing provider figures and do not establish verification of every asset or destination. Simulation uses include finding land, building and infrastructure-exposure inputs and retrieving documented geospatial layers. It relates to data-microsoft-global-ml-building-footprints as an existing global building resource, without implying that every hosted derivative is identical. The metadata repository and one infrastructure example were inspected; no Earth Engine jobs or dataset downloads were run.
